CardDescription.DefaultText: Brown water, half sea and half rain, lapping among the roots. You can wash in it, or grope along the muddy bottom between the roots.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Wade in and scrub off the road, the sweat and the sand.

CollectionMessages.DefaultText: A shark came out of the blue and bit you before you could reach the shallows.
A banded sea krait struck at your leg and slid away into the weed.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Duck under and feel along the muddy bottom between the roots for crabs and weed.

CollectionMessages.DefaultText: A shark came out of the blue and bit you before you could reach the shallows.
A banded sea krait struck at your leg and slid away into the weed.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Dip a bowl or other liquid container into the sea and fill it with salt water. Boil it dry in a fire for a little salt; it is not fit to drink.
Cast a line from the shore and wait. What you land depends on this water and on how much of each fish is left in the sea.
Heave a net out from the shore and haul it back in. A net that comes up full holds two of a fish rather than one; what it holds depends on this water and on how much of each fish is left in the sea.
Wade into the shallows and spear what swims by. Needs daylight and a steady arm.

CollectionMessages.DefaultText: A shark came out of the blue and bit you before you could reach the shallows.
A banded sea krait struck at your leg and slid away into the weed.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Wade out and stake the trap in the shallows. It catches fish on its own while you are away.
Wade out and stake the funnel trap in the shallows. It catches the sea's fish on its own while you are away.
